verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud marketing claims 'Understand production systems faster using natural language' and documents an MCP server that lets AI agents connect to Grafana, plus Sift for automated investigations/anomaly detection — suggesting some natural-language query capability. However there is no first-party walkthrough or independent hands-on evidence showing a user typing a question and receiving an actual generated query or chart. missing for 10: concrete documented workflow/example of NL-to-query/chart generation, independent or hands-on verification that the MCP/Sift features actually produce real charts from natural language.
